howto.goal: Beat the dealer without going over 21. A two-card 21 is blackjack and pays 3:2.
howto.setup: One hand at a time against the house dealer. Bets are paid from the Jackpot wallet.

sections.title: Betting
sections.text: Pick a stake from the ladder and the chips leave your wallet. A win pays even money, a push returns the bet, and blackjack pays 3:2.

sections.title: Hit or stand
sections.text: Hit takes another card, stand stops, and double doubles the stake for one more card on your first two. The dealer stands on all 17s.

sections.title: The table stays open
sections.text: A finished hand goes straight back to betting with the last cards shown. The table never ends on its own, and a broke player gets a fresh stack.

controls: Click a bet button to deal a hand.
Click Hit, Stand or Double while the hand is live.
The dealer's second card stays hidden until the hand is settled.

demo.intro: One bet and the cards come out.

lines.say: The table waits for a bet. The stake is paid from your wallet.
Bet placed: you get two cards and the dealer shows one. Now hit, stand or double.

demo.outro: Stand on a strong total and hit a weak one; the dealer must keep drawing to 17.

steps.say: Pick a small stake with a bet button and the hand is dealt.
Hit while your total is low, and stand when it is strong enough.
Blackjack pays 3:2. A push returns your stake and the table keeps going.
